title: Learn love from those who live it
summary: Companions teach love by embrace, example, and honest asking. Take the question into sangat.
lifeApplication: When remembrance goes cold, sit beside someone whose practice still glows and ask one plain question. Let their lived virtue teach what private guessing cannot.

source.shortMeaning: Companions teach love by embrace, example, and honest asking.
source.lifeApplication: When longing swells, ask a practiced heart how it keeps love warm.

evidence.coreClaim: Companions teach love by embrace, example, and honest asking.
evidence.turn: Let this stay with you: holy company teaches the heart how to remember well.
